title: SUPREME published results: Pins Face Recognition
paper_title: SUPREME: A Multi-GPU Framework for Reproducible Image Unlearning Method Evaluation
seed_protocol: Matched: J = K = 1; training, unlearning and evaluation seeds coincide within a run.
aggregation: Full-class: average over five forget classes within each seed, then mean and standard deviation over ten seeds. Random: mean and standard deviation over ten seeds for a 0.1% forget set.
data_kind: Published aggregate values, transcribed at the paper's two-decimal precision. These files contain no individual-seed measurements or model checkpoints.
accuracy_unit: percent for raw accuracy; percentage points for differences
difference_definition: Unlearned minus retrained. Closer to zero indicates closer agreement on that metric, not proof of data removal.
error_bars: One standard deviation across seeds, not confidence intervals. Symmetric bars may extend beyond a metric's physical range.
rounding: Differences were copied from the reported difference tables, not recalculated from rounded raw means. Values displayed as -0.00 retain the source sign in CSV.
excluded: UNSIR is excluded from the random-sample scenario by design. Original-model values and execution times are not supplied by these three paper tables.

tables.pins_main.csv: Table 1: Accuracy differences and layer-wise distances (LaTeX label tab:pins_results_main).
tables.pins_additional.csv: Appendix: MIA differences and activation distances (LaTeX label tab:pins_results_appendix).
tables.pins_raw.csv: Appendix: Raw accuracy and MIA summaries, including the retrained reference (LaTeX label tab:pins_raw_values).
